meta.name: marketing-analytics
meta.description: Sets up, audits, and reports on marketing measurement — tracking plans, event schemas, attribution models, and the dashboards built on them. Use this to instrument a site or product, audit tracking nobody trusts, choose or interpret an attribution model, build reporting that answers a specific question, or reconcile numbers that disagree between tools.

copy.tagline: 搭建可信的营销衡量与归因体系
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你的营销数据来自多个工具,想统一衡量效果
copy.tagline_en: Set up reliable marketing measurement and attribution reporting
copy.fit_line_en: For you if your marketing data sits across many tools and you need one reliable view.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会先引导你书面定义每个跟踪事件(何时触发、带哪些属性、回答什么问题)，再据此搭建埋点；审计时会让你自己操作验证事件是否到达；选择归因模型时会说明各模型的偏向；做报告时要求写明指标、对比期和对应决策。
howto.when: 当你要求为网站或产品做埋点、审计跟踪数据、选择归因模型等营销测量相关任务时触发。

say.text: 帮我写一份跟踪计划，定义注册事件何时触发和需要哪些属性。
say.note: Claude 会先让你说明这个事件要回答什么问题。

say.text: 审计我们网站的转化跟踪，看看事件有没有丢或重复触发。
say.note: Claude 会带你亲自操作来验证事件是否正常到达。

howto.what_en: Claude first makes you write down each tracking event (when it fires, properties, question it answers) before building tracking. It verifies events manually in audits. It explains attribution biases and demands metric, comparison period, and decision in reports.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask to set up analytics tracking, audit untrusted data, pick or explain an attribution model, or build a specific report.

say_en.text: Write a tracking plan for the signup event: when it fires and its properties.
say_en.note: Claude will ask what question the event should answer.

say_en.text: Audit our site's conversion tracking: are events missing or double-firing?
say_en.note: Claude will guide you to verify by doing the action yourself.

say_en.text: Compare first-touch vs last-touch attribution: why do results differ so much?
say_en.note: Claude will explain the known bias of each model.
